questions.question: What is meant by plot in a story?
questions.solution_html:
• Drama is a literary genre meant for performance, using dialogue and action to tell a
  • story. It relies on actors, stage directions, and visual elements to portray characters and

  • performance, drama explores human emotions and relationships, blending literature

questions.question: How is magic realism employed in Midnight’s Children?
questions.solution_html:
• In Midnight’s Children, Salman Rushdie uses magic realism as a key postcolonial tool
  • to connect personal and national histories. The technique blends magical elements with
  • realistic settings to reflect India’s complex post-independence identity. Through Saleem
  • Sinai and the other “midnight’s children,” Rushdie symbolizes the nation’s diversity and
  • transformation. By merging history, myth, and fantasy, he challenges Western notions
  • of historical truth. Ultimately, this fusion affirms an Indian storytelling tradition that
  • unites the personal, political, and mythical.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: unites the personal, political, and mythical.

questions.question: Discuss how linear and non-linear temporal structures manipulate pacing, suspense, and character development?
questions.solution_html:
• The temporal narrative structure in fiction refers to the arrangement of events in time as
  • they are narrated, shaping the reader’s understanding of plot, suspense, and character
  • growth. It can be linear, following chronological order, or nonlinear, using techniques
  • like flashbacks, flash -forwards, and time loops. Flashbacks reveal past events, while
  • flash-forwards hint at future outcomes. Stories that begin in medias res start in the
  • middle of action and reveal earlier events gradually. Some narratives use circular time
  • where events repeat or the ending mirrors the beginning. A linear narrative presents
  • events in chronological order, creating a smooth pace and clear character growth as the
  • story builds toward its climax. Suspense develops naturally as readers anticipate
  • upcoming events. In contrast, a nonlinear narrative rearra nges time through flashbacks
  • or shifts, altering pacing and deepening emotional impact. This structure builds suspense
  • by revealing information gradually and enhances character depth by uncovering hidden
  • pasts or future outcomes.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: pasts or future outcomes.
